title: Zesty Mexican Palm Sugar Mole Poblano
description: A herbal and snappy vegan Mexican dish featuring palm sugar, made in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware cookware, inspired by the Jalisco style mole poblano.
instructions: Roast the ancho chilies in a 350 degree oven for 5 minutes.
Grind the roasted chilies into a powder using a spice grinder.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the ttukbaegi earthenware cookware over medium heat.
Add the sliced almonds and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground ancho chilies, cinnamon, and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the palm sugar, raisins, and 2 cups of water to the cookware and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the mole poblano over rice or vegetables.
